name: Ghost
description: A wavering spirit with a face contorted in rage or sadness.

special_abilities.name: Greater Undead
special_abilities.description: Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal
special_abilities.description: In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.

special_abilities.name: Life Drain
special_abilities.description: 1d4 CON damage. Death if reduced to 0 CON.

special_abilities.name: Possess
special_abilities.description: Must be corporeal. One target, close range. Contested CHA check. If ghost wins, it inhabits target's body and controls it for 2d4 rounds.
